Call characters follow entry visibility.name: Call characters follow entry visibility
Call characters follow entry visibility.using: exists(select 1 from call_entries e where e.id = entry_id)

Authors edit characters while submission.name: Authors edit characters while submissions are open
Authors edit characters while submission.using:
exists(select 1 from call_entries e join calls c on c.id = e.call_id
        where e.id = entry_id and e.author_id = (select public.current_user_id()) and c.phase = 'submissions')
Authors edit characters while submission.withCheck:
exists(select 1 from call_entries e join calls c on c.id = e.call_id
        where e.id = entry_id and e.author_id = (select public.current_user_id()) and c.phase = 'submissions')

Approved entries are public, own and adm.name: Approved entries are public, own and admin always
Approved entries are public, own and adm.using: status = 'approved' or (select public.current_user_id()) = author_id or (select public.is_admin())

Authors enter their published scripts wh.name: Authors enter their published scripts while submissions are open
Authors enter their published scripts wh.withCheck:
(select public.current_user_id()) = author_id and status = 'pending' and review_reason is null
        and exists(select 1 from scripts s where s.id = script_id and s.author_id = call_entries.author_id and s.status = 'published')
        and exists(select 1 from calls c where c.id = call_id and c.phase = 'submissions')

Authors withdraw pending entries while s.name: Authors withdraw pending entries while submissions are open
Authors withdraw pending entries while s.using:
(select public.current_user_id()) = author_id and status = 'pending'
        and exists(select 1 from calls c where c.id = call_id and c.phase = 'submissions')

Interpreters, admins and (shortlisted) a.name: Interpreters, admins and (shortlisted) authors read castings
Interpreters, admins and (shortlisted) a.using:
(select public.current_user_id()) = interpreter_id or (select public.is_admin())
        or (status in ('shortlisted', 'selected') and exists(select 1 from call_characters ch join call_entries e on e.id = ch.entry_id
          where ch.id = character_id and e.author_id = (select public.current_user_id())))

Approved interpreters send castings whil.name: Approved interpreters send castings while the call is casting
Approved interpreters send castings whil.withCheck:
(select public.current_user_id()) = interpreter_id and status = 'submitted'
        and exists(select 1 from interpreter_profiles i where i.user_id = interpreter_id and i.status = 'approved')
        and exists(select 1 from call_characters ch join call_entries e on e.id = ch.entry_id join calls c on c.id = e.call_id
          where ch.id = character_id and e.status = 'approved' and c.phase = 'casting')

Interpreters withdraw their take while t.name: Interpreters withdraw their take while the call is casting
